scenario: Duplicate aggregation across lines under the same time model requires `as <label>` on every line per LSER.6.8.3. Two `mean sliding` declarations without labels are rejected with DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_DUPLICATE_AGG_NEEDS_LABEL. Authors who want both must label them (e.g. `mean sliding 10_min as short` / `mean sliding 1_h as long`).
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope ttl 1_min:
    entity_id: String
    state: Float

series Sensor.state (by: entity_id):
    mean sliding 10_min
    mean sliding 1_h
